callees.name: _erlang_files
callees.pre_condition: proj_dir resolves to an existing directory.
callees.post_condition: Returns a list of absolute paths to every .erl source file discovered under proj_dir. Returns an empty list when no .erl files exist.

callees.name: _caller_module
callees.pre_condition: file_path is an absolute path to a file within the analyzed Erlang project tree.
callees.post_condition: Returns a module identifier string derived from the path components relative to the project root.

callees.name: _function_id
callees.pre_condition: uri is a file URI string; name is a non-empty string from an ELP symbol.
callees.post_condition: Returns a canonical function identifier string derived from uri and name. Raises ValueError when the inputs do not form a valid function identifier.
